summary: Formalize the full PTX 9.4 instruction language and computing model, and support proofs that GPU kernels implement TorchLean network specifications.
Explain the computing model and the conditions of each correctness claim through source-linked documentation and reproducible examples.
remaining: Restricted memory models, individual-thread execution and reusable proof rules, and kernels sharing one allocation are implemented. Full PTX coverage, the settled meaning of observing a write when a read mixes bytes from different writes, general interactions between threads with data-dependent instructions, TorchLean interfaces, numerical and backward infrastructure, and application examples remain unimplemented.
